pages.rationale: Frame 1 is reproduced region for region: toolbar, ribbon with terminal-type readout, source block with the filter/selection rows, the 10-tile member grid with verdict dots and pager, members-overlaid, scope matrix, source settings and provenance. Frame 1b's 4-tab picker, family table and swap note are all there, and the family rows follow canon (F-04 spike train / F-11 burst) rather than the frame's contradicting F-11 biphasic / F-12 burst, which is the right call per spec section 0. Every state in the manifest paints: swapped to F-07 rewires the whole page (202 of 212, 4x8 scope matrix, its own provenance and family colour), running shows a veil plus progress plus Cancel, empty-scope-by-click marks 01 and 02 stale with a callout, save-template and add-stage open real modals/popovers. Deductions: the sort control drops to a second row, the ?scope=none deep link does not mark the chain stale where the click path does, picker text truncates, and the frame's one blue seed dot is green.

findings.title: sort control wraps to a second row
findings.detail: The frame keeps adjudicated only / exclude artifacts / distance / recording / channel / sort on one 30 px filter row. At 1440 px the app wraps 'sort distance to medoid' onto its own row, pushing the selection row and the whole member grid about 30 px down.

findings.title: ?scope=none leaves 01 and 02 badged cached
findings.detail: Reaching the same situation by clicking 'none' turns both ribbon badges amber-stale, shows the 'the source changed - 01 and 02 show the last run until you re-run' callout and flips the primary to 'Re-run from 01'. The deep link ?scope=none shows 0 of 17 in scope and 'no members in scope' while both badges still read cached and the primary still reads Run chain. Two paths to one state disagree about staleness.

findings.title: picker columns truncate canon values
findings.detail: The Prior run tab shows '#140 F-03 slope interro...', template 'sharkfin_slope_...' and the disabled reason for #97 as 'the run e...'. The frame's picker shows every family/run label in full. A disabled row whose reason is unreadable is a disabled-with-reason rule that does not land.

findings.title: no member carries the blue seed verdict
findings.detail: The frame gives s-0344 a blue dot (seed); the app draws it green (interesting). The legend still lists a blue 'seed' entry, so the legend has a swatch with no instance on the page, and the family's human seed is invisible in the grid.

pages.rationale: Every region of frames 2, 2b and 2c is present and wired: the anatomy card with units/marks selects, mark legend, 'rules resolved cleanly' chip, event readout, the 10-thumbnail sliding strip with rule flags and 'jump to flagged (n)', the rose with its depth colour ramp and the selected-event marker, the four rule controls with the flagged-events warning, and the per-event table with sortable headers and CSV. 2b swaps the rose for the seeded sampled overlay with resample and sample size (P8), and pages the strip to 41-50. 2c's stale state is complete: amber card, preview copy verbatim, '5 samples (was 3)', discard, stale badges, amber estimate, 'Re-run from 01', and the stale veil; discard restores cleanly. The timescale rule (times x10, slopes /10) is applied consistently. Deductions are all visual: the frame's amber onset-to-trough band is absent and the marks are drawn as labelled full-height rules rather than points on the curve, the header subtitle never changes, the stale notice is a banner rather than the frame's floating pill, the pending slider stays blue instead of amber, and the readout wraps on the large family.

findings.title: amber onset-to-trough band missing; marks drawn as rules, not points
findings.detail: The frame shades the onset-to-trough interval pale amber and puts the marks on the curve itself: a blue onset dot, a blue square at the steepest sample, a red trough dot, a green depth segment and a grey chord. The app draws no band and instead draws three full-height vertical rules labelled onset / steepest / trough, so the legend's dot shapes and colours (steepest purple, trough red, depth green) no longer match anything drawn.

findings.title: header subtitle drops the event count and never reflects the state
findings.detail: Frame 2 header: '01 Resolve spans | slope analysis | F-03 sharkfin | 16 events'; the app stops at 'F-03 sharkfin'. Frame 2c replaces the tail with '1 unsaved rule change'; the app still reads 'F-03 sharkfin' while the rest of the page is stale.

findings.title: stale notice is a full-width banner and the pending slider stays blue
findings.detail: The frame floats 'showing last run - results are stale until re-run' as an amber pill over the plot, and draws the changed steepest-window slider track amber to mark the pending edit. The app puts the notice in a full-width banner above the plot (pushing the plot down about 35 px) and leaves the slider blue, so the only amber inside the Rules card is the preview text.

findings.title: steepest-window slider is a third of the frame width; readout wraps
findings.detail: The frame gives the slider a roughly 190 px track inside the rules row; the app's is about 70 px with the handle pinned at the left edge for value 3, which reads as a control at its minimum. On large-family the event readout wraps peakedness onto a second line and pushes 'jump to flagged (3)' onto a third row instead of sitting right-aligned on the strip meta row as the frame shows.

pages.rationale: The layout matches frame 3 closely - three histogram cards with their null behind and one-line verdicts, the Scaling card with pair Seg, axes select, beta and null-beta tiles, the occurrence timeline with per-recording tau, the six-control parameters card and the summary tiles with CSV / Figures / Stage 1 outlier - and frame 3c's Feature wiring popover is fully built (seven wiring rows, upstream feature chips, add scaling pair, the 'any block emitting Features' footnote), with the ribbon chip and header renaming to 01 Spike shape. Two things cost it real marks. The small-family state reprints F-03's statistics verbatim over F-04's nine events, which is misleading rather than merely wrong. And colour-by-recording drops the grey null behind every histogram and re-bins the data, so the state the frame uses to show per-recording structure is the one state where P10's null disappears. On top of those, the scatter has no 95 % CI band, the header subtitle never changes with the state, and the wiring popover covers the wrong card.

findings.title: F-04 reports F-03's numbers verbatim
findings.detail: ?family=F-04 shows 9 events but the exponent tile still reads 1.42 [1.18-1.66], R2 0.81, and the verdict lines are word-for-word F-03's: 'dip test p 0.21 - n too small to call modes', 'CV 0.31 - null CV 0.98 [0.71-1.22] - p < 0.01', 'median 0.066 - null median 0.021 - p < 0.01'; the summary tile pairs events 9 with beta 1.42. Only the n changes. The inventory defines this state as 'too few to fit' (9 members, 0 adjudicated), and section 3 says nothing may claim more than it knows - a fitted exponent with a tight CI over nine points is exactly that claim.

findings.title: colour-by drops the null behind the histograms and re-bins them
findings.detail: In default the three histograms draw grey null bars behind the observed bars with a 'null / observed' legend. With colour=recording the grey null and its legend entry vanish, leaving only the stacked per-recording bars, and the bins change: inter-event interval goes from seven bars topping out at 6 to a single stacked bar of 12 at 0.0, so the same 16 events read as a different distribution. P10 requires the null distribution behind every plot, and the frame keeps the grey null bars behind the stacked colours.

findings.title: scaling scatter has no 95 % CI band
findings.detail: The frame draws a pale blue confidence ribbon around the fit line and lists 'event / null / 95% CI' in the legend. The app draws a bare line and its legend reads 'event / null / fit'. The CI numbers survive in the exponent tile, but the picture no longer shows the uncertainty the frame puts on it.

findings.title: header subtitle is fixed instead of per-state
findings.detail: Frame 3 reads '02 Aggregate | distributions and scaling | F-03 sharkfin | 16 events' and frame 3b changes it to 'coloured by recording | depth ~ max slope'. The app shows 'distributions and scaling | F-03 sharkfin' in both states and never carries the event count (the wired-from-spike-shape state does change it correctly, so the mechanism exists).

findings.title: wiring popover covers the wrong card; duplicated axis caption
findings.detail: Frame 3c anchors the Feature wiring popover low and centre, over the Scaling card, leaving all three histograms readable. The app anchors it at the top, hiding the Half-width histogram entirely and overlapping the ribbon. Separately, the scatter's x caption prints 'half-width ->' and 'half_width_s' next to each other under the axis (and 'duration ->' / 'duration_s' in the default pair), where the frame prints one.

findings.title: toolbar estimate contradicts the ribbon badges
findings.detail: The empty state badges 01 and 02 as 'new' and says '01 has not run yet', while the toolbar to its right still reads '~ 6 s - 3 of 3 cached'. Nothing is cached in this state.
